personal.name: Subhojeet Chowdhury
personal.summary: Software engineer with 2+ years of experience specialising in agentic AI systems, cloud-native AWS architectures, and full-stack enterprise applications. Career arc spans full-stack HR applications to autonomous AWS-native WFA systems.

phases.title: Autonomous WFA System (Phase 4 — Current, AWS)
bullets: Designing an end-to-end autonomous Workforce Administration (WFA) system on AWS: Email ingestion → PII masking → Bedrock classification (Nova Pro) → human review → Oracle HRM updates via SQS, Lambda, S3 and DynamoDB.

Built document decomposition layer to split multi-request emails into parallel sub-workflows; designed HITL checkpoints for data incompleteness, compliance failures, and approval gates before committing any HRM changes.

phases.title: Agentic AI (Phase 3)
bullets: Led migration of rule-based HR apps to multi-agent orchestrated workflows using LangGraph and LangChain; built AI chatbot handling employee queries on leave, payroll, and HR policies — cutting help-desk load significantly.
Deployed RAG pipelines over large HR knowledge bases for grounded, policy-aware responses; built an AI interview-scheduling agent automating slot matching and candidate communication.

phases.title: Full-Stack & ITSM (Phases 1–2)
bullets: Built end-to-end HR operations suite (Angular/React + Python/Flask) covering recruitment, onboarding, payroll, and offboarding; integrated with ServiceNow for structured ticket routing.
Configured and extended FreshService for a ~300,000-user blue-collar workforce (Applied Universal), automating ticket classification, routing, and resolution tracking across HR and IT.

projects.title: SpeakType
projects.tagline: A lightning-fast, privacy-first, cross-application dictation tool.

architectureCards.title: Any App, Anywhere.
architectureCards.description: No extensions to install. No API keys to paste into every app you use. A lightweight daemon binds to your OS natively. Just hold ALT+SPACE anywhere, and start speaking.

architectureCards.title: 100% Private.
architectureCards.description: Your voice shouldn't be training someone else's model. We use an embedded inference engine to process your raw audio strictly on your local device.

architectureCards.title: Context Chameleon.
architectureCards.description: It doesn't just transcribe; it adapts. By detecting your active window, our backend routes your text to an LLM to perfectly match the tone—formal for Outlook, casual for Slack, syntactic for VS Code.

architectureCards.title: Instantly There.
architectureCards.description: Once the context is refined, the text doesn't just copy to your clipboard. It natively injects and streams into your active text field in under 700ms total latency.
